metadata.name: RetrieveProductWallets
metadata.description: Use this API to retrieve the wallets available on the product.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Institution ID of product. Example : 1230 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of records to be returned in a page Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100,50  will return 100 or 50 transactions at once. Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Page Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 0,1,2 Allowable Values: 5

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: InstitutionID
children.description: Institution ID of product. Example : 1230

children.name: ProductID
children.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758

children.name: WalletMasterID
children.description: Wallet Master ID of wallet group. Example:1001

children.name: WalletID
children.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: MCCPlanName
children.description: MCC Plan Name mapped on wallet. Example:Default,saving etc

children.name: WalletName
children.description: Wallet Name Example: Rent wallet

children.name: WalletType
children.description: Wallet Type . Example:1=Default, 2=MCC, 3=Saving, 4=Health Care

children.name: AutoLinkWallet
children.description: Flag that wallet will be Auto Linked or not Example:0=No, 1=Yes

children.name: WalletCurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Currency Code of the wallet. Example:026

children.name: WalletCurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Currency of the wallet. Example:USD

children.name: AllowLoads
children.description: Loads are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowUnloads
children.description: Unloads are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowSchemeDebitTransactions
children.description: Scheme Debit Transactions are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowSchemeCreditTransactions
children.description: Scheme Credit Transactions are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowIncomingWalletTransfer
children.description: Incoming Wallet Transfers are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowOutgoingWalletTransfer
children.description: Outgoing Wallet Transfers are allowed on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowOutgoingSweep
children.description: Outgoing Sweep is allowed on particular wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: AllowIncomingSweep
children.description: Flag to decide incoming sweeps allowed on the wallet or not. Valid values: true or false Example: true

children.name: YearlyMaximumLimit
children.description: Maximum amount of net contribution a wallet can have in a calendar year , can be defined when wallet ID is provided. Valid values 0-9 Example : 5000.00

children.name: ForfeitBalance
children.description: Forfeit Balance Setup of the wallet. Example:0 = None, 1 = Immediate, 2 = RolloverAmount, 3 = Grace Period

children.name: YearlyRolloverAmount
children.description: Yearly Rollover Amount of the wallet. Example:1000.00

children.name: GracePeriodInDays
children.description: Number of grace days allowed to utilize the remaining wallet balance. Example:30

children.name: HealthCareEligibleAmount
children.description: Health Care Eligible Amount setup on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: PrescriptionEligibleAmount
children.description: Prescription Eligible Amount setup on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: ClinicOrOtherHealthCareEligibleAmount
children.description: Clinic/Other Health Care Eligible Amount setup on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: DentalCareEligibleAmount
children.description: Dental Care Eligible Amountsetup on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: VisionOrOpticalEligibleAmount
children.description: Vision/Optical Eligible Amount setup on the wallet or not. Example:true, false

children.name: CreationDateTime
children.description: Creation Date and Time of the wallet. Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example: 2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: Priority
children.description: Priority of the wallet/Saving pocket. Valid values 0-9 Example : 1,2 etc.

children.name: Status
children.description: Status of the wallet. Example:0 =Inactive,1 =Active,2 =Closedd
